name: JE_IT_EXEMPT_LETTERS
description: JE_IT_EXEMPT_LETTERS contains exemption letter information for suppliers. This table corresponds to the Exemption Letters window.

columns.name: EXEMPT_LETTER_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal Entity Identifier

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier

columns.name: EXEMPT_LETTER_NUMBER
columns.description: Exemption letter identifier

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Start date the exemption letter becomes effective

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: End date the exemption letter is effective

columns.name: LETTER_TYPE
columns.description: Exempt Letter Type

columns.name: LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Exempt limit amount

columns.name: CLAUSE_REF
columns.description: The clause of the Italian legislation concerning exemption letters which is relevant to a supplier

columns.name: PRINT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if letter is to be printed (Y or N)

columns.name: ISSUE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if letter is to be issued to supplier (Y or N)

columns.name: CUSTOM_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if letter is to be sent to a standard supplier or to Customs

columns.name: EXEMPT_YEAR
columns.description: Year of the EFFECTIVE_FROM column

columns.name: ISSUE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the exemption letter was first issued

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
